item.text: The README and tests specify sorting, deduplication, consecutive grouping, empty input handling, and no input mutation. I’ll implement that directly using a sorted set so any iterable is supported.
The implementation is in place. The `pytest` executable is not installed in this environment, so I’ll verify with Python directly using the repository’s test cases and compile the module.

from ranges import compact_ranges

assert compact_ranges([]) == []
assert compact_ranges([3, 1, 2, 2, 7]) == [(1, 3), (7, 7)]
assert compact_ranges([-3, -1, -2, 4]) == [(-3, -1), (4, 4)]
source = [3, 1, 2]
compact_ranges(source)
assert source == [3, 1, 2]
